title: Shinsegae I&C Brings Meta's New AI Glasses to Korea: 9 Models, Prices and Channels (KRX: 035510)
content:
Korea Supply Chain Brief · September 28, 2026

Shinsegae I&C (KRX: 035510), Meta's official distributor in Korea, will bring nine models of Meta's AI glasses to the Korean market, including the new Meta-branded line unveiled at Meta Connect 2026. Here is what is launching, at what price, through which channels, and where this Korean company actually sits in Meta's glasses business.

CompanyRoleEvidence
Shinsegae I&C
KOSPI: 035510		Exclusive national distributor of Meta devices in KoreaAnnounced (company statement, reported by ZDNet Korea, Sep 28, 2026)

What is launching in Korea

  • 9 models, 21 SKUs in total.
  • Meta-branded glasses: Meta Capri, Meta Nova, Meta Fury (first shown in June) and Meta Adventurer. Same core features as earlier AI glasses (camera, open-ear audio, voice-driven AI assistant) with more frame designs and colors. Korean prices range from KRW 480,000 to 860,000 depending on model and lenses.
  • LISA Edition: two models based on Meta Adventurer and Meta Capri, made with BLACKPINK's Lisa, priced at KRW 640,000.
  • Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 3): slimmer frame, battery life up to 9 hours, a new action button that launches Meta AI directly, and a six-microphone array that the company says blocks over 90% of ambient noise. From KRW 740,000.

Distribution, not components

When foreign investors search for "Korean Meta glasses stocks," they often expect a parts supplier. Shinsegae I&C is not that. It is the IT services arm of the Shinsegae retail group and acts as Meta's Korean distributor: it imports the devices and sells them through Shinsegae's own stores and partner channels. Its exposure to AI glasses is therefore tied to Korean retail sales volume, not to Meta's global production.

The report does not name any Korean company as a component supplier for these glasses, so we do not name one here.

Quick FAQ

Who sells Meta Ray-Ban glasses in Korea?
Shinsegae I&C, Meta's national distributor for its devices, according to the company.

How much are Meta AI glasses in Korea?
The new Meta-branded models cost KRW 480,000 to 860,000; Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 starts at KRW 740,000; the LISA Edition is KRW 640,000.

Is Shinsegae I&C a Meta parts supplier?
No. It is a distributor. It sells the finished glasses in Korea.
